Compare coherent Tucker4 vs independent per-disease Tucker3

Source: R/tucker4.R
compare_coherent_vs_independent.Rd

Compare coherent Tucker4 vs independent per-disease Tucker3

Usage

compare_coherent_vs_independent(
  X_ilr,
  mx_all,
  mx_disease_list,
  mx_disease_smooth_list,
  pop_all,
  disease_order,
  disease_configs,
  years,
  ages,
  groups,
  train_idx,
  test_idx,
  calib_tucker4,
  width = 5
)

Arguments

X_ilr

4D ILR array.

mx_all

3D all-cause array.

mx_disease_list

Named list of disease arrays (raw).

mx_disease_smooth_list

Named list of smoothed disease arrays.

pop_all

3D population array.

disease_order

Character vector.

disease_configs

Named list of mort_config objects.

years, ages, groups

Study dimensions.

train_idx, test_idx

Integer index vectors.

calib_tucker4

Output of calibrate_tucker4().

width

Age-group width.

Value

data.table with per-disease coherent vs independent MASE.
